evi.4wave~.digest: Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs

evi.adsr~.digest: ADSR envelope generator, same features as adsr~ but with logarithmic segments
evi.adsr~.description: ADSR by default, but actually DAHDSHR capabale generator via attributes. Logarithmic segment shapes but still capable of controlling poly~ and thispoly~

evi.algoverb~.description: Relatively expensive algorithmic reverb with many tweekable parameters, 15 embedded presets and an internal pattrstorage system. The reverb is modular, with pre delay, early reflections and late reflections all controllable individually, as well as high quality linear SVF filters in both the feedback path and end of wet path. Loosely based on a Martijn Zwartjes Reaktor ensemble. The MSP abstraction does a lot of massaging of the input parameters, so when using the gen~ abstraction study the internal Param declarations.

evi.allpass~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP allpass~ filter delay

evi.am~.digest: Basic AM processor with saturation and choice of LFO shapes

evi.arpnotch~.digest: A nonlinear SVF Notch filter which can morph between LP..Notch..HP

evi.backverb~.digest: Ursa Major reverb unit with saturating feedback
evi.backverb~.description: A strange reverb-like effect, based on Christopher Moore's legendary 1978 Ursa Major Space Station algorithm. This is not an attempt to model the 1970's digital hardware, but more of a trope on it, although it does sound very close to the original with the right settings. Nonlinearities and trap filters have been added, much as you might find in an analog delay, as well as different modulation, interpolation, smoothing and filtering modifications. Also cheap on CPU.

evi.baxandall~.digest: Emulation of a classic baxandall EQ

evi.biquad.filter~.digest: All-in-one biquad coefficient calculator and filter section

evi.biquadcoeff.digest: Message rate biquad coefficients calculator with selection of 40 different filter types.
evi.biquadcoeff.description: evi.biquadcoeff is an efficient message rate coefficients calculator for the biquad~ (or evi.biquad~) object. It is intended to replace filtergraph~ for when you do not need a UI or you want to take advantage of the more filter types available. High level filter parameters are frequency, gain and Q. The units used for frequency and gain can be set via attributes.

evi.biquadcoeff~.digest: Signal rate biquad coefficient calculator with 40 available filter types

evi.blitwaves~.digest: No aliasing BLIT oscillators with a choice of simultaneous wave shapes outputs

evi.butterworthlp6~.digest: Unique 6th order Butterworth Lowpass filter created from evi.bp~ sections after Miller Puckette

evi.butterworthlp8~.digest: TPT variable order Butterworth Lowpass filter

evi.cfsmooth~.digest: Signal smoother particularly well suited to smoothing cutoff frequencies
evi.cfsmooth~.description: Based on Andy Simper's smoother, evi.cfsmooth~ tracks the input value via the bandpass output of an SVF filter and logarithmically updates. Smoothing is specified in both ramp time (ms) and filter cutoff (Hz).

evi.chorus.digital~.digest: A basic digital Chorus implementation, with multiple stages and saturation

evi.clip~.digest: Anti-aliased clipping algorithms for your audio

evi.comb~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP comb~ filter delay

evi.cross~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP cross~ filter as Likwitz-Riley

evi.crossover.allpass~.digest: Allpass filter for aligning audio chains using evieve crossover filters

evi.crossover.sum~.digest: Allpass alignment summing for use with evi.crossover.3band~

evi.crossover~.digest: A choice of 2 or 4 pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters

evi.damp.macro~.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for simple low/high onepole damping filters

evi.damp~.digest: Onepole pass/shelf damping filters with simultaneous outputs

evi.dcblock~.description: A basic dc blocking filter utility for cleaning your audio signals.

evi.detune~.digest: A quirky digital Detune effect with filtering and saturation

evi.dfm~.digest: Classic MS20 filter emulation based on DFM1 by Tony Hardie-Bick
evi.dfm~.description: This is a well known open source MS20 filter emulation of the old school. The agressive character of the MS20 is captured as a defining feature. The scaling of frequency and Q is a feature of the original filter and is maintained here, measured against an actual MS20 filter control response. Like the MS20 filter, the filter is switchable here between the 12dB Lowpass and 6dB (special) Highpass responses.

evi.eq3~.digest: Mono TPT 3-band EQ with signal rate modulation of all parameters

evi.eq3stereo~.digest: Stereo TPT 3-band EQ with signal rate modulation of all parameters

evi.eq5~.digest: 5-band TPT EQ with parameter rate control of all attributes

evi.eq8~.digest: 8-band TPT EQ with parameter rate control of all attributes

evi.expsmooth~.description: A simple and efficient ramp generator with exponential curve and ramp time specified in milliseconds.

evi.filter.eq~.digest: EQ type TPT filters with a choice of 7 filters

evi.filter.morph~.digest: TPT SVF which can morph between LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP

evi.filter.shelving~.digest: A chain of two two-pole TPT shelving filters

evi.filter~.digest: All-in-one TPT filter section with a choice of 12 filters

evi.flanger.digital~.digest: A basic two-stage Flanger effect with saturation

evi.formantfilter.morph~.digest: A formant filter with smoothly morphing singing voice type, sung vowel sounds and filter types.
evi.formantfilter.morph~.description: While evi.formantfilter~ uses a bank of resonant filters, evi.formantfilter.morph~ uses a bank of morphing EQ filters. The formant effect is lesser, but the morphing ability creates new sonic possibilities. The far right 'Morph' inlet allows for morphing the internal bank of filters between LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP 0..1, and adds another dimension along with the voice and vowel morphing to shape the sound. All inputs can be audio rate modulated.

evi.formantfilter~.digest: A classic formant filter which can smoothly morph singing voice type and sung vowel sounds for voxy filtering effects on your audio streams
evi.formantfilter~.description: evi.formantfilter~ uses a bank of resonant filters (the same TPT filters as in evi.reson~) for each formant. Interpolation and warping controls allow for a wide variety of effects, as well as controlling the filters themselves.

evi.formantosc~.digest: A classic formant oscillator which can smoothly morph singing voice type and sung vowel sounds for voxy effects.
evi.formantosc~.description: evi.formantosc~ allows for smoothly interpolating vowels and voices over a fundamental frequency. It gives the classic lofi physical model effect but with many attributes to modify the output and audio rate modulate it for an interesting source.

evi.freezeverb~.digest: Classic freeverb reverb algorithm with buttery smooth freezing effect
evi.freezeverb~.description: This is a basic Schroeder reverb effect but with additional filtering and controls, very servicable for certain situations. But the main feature here is the ability to smoothly capture the input audio in the recirculating feedback path in a way which gives a forever freezing effect. This can be triggered and released with wet+dry or with wet alone.

evi.freqshift.hilbert~.digest: Time-domain Hilbert frequency shifter effect with three simultaneous sidebands outputs
evi.freqshift.hilbert~.description: Like MSP freqshift~ but with a different hilbert filter and additional features, such as anti-aliased saturation.

evi.freqshift.weaver~.digest: Time domain frequency shifter after D. K. Weaver's famous 'third method'

evi.gigaverb~.digest: Classic gigaverb reverb algorithm, mono in / stereo out, fdn / allpass
evi.gigaverb~.description: A mono-in, stereo-out reverb implementation by Juhana Sadeharju. Originally Max/MSP-ified by Olaf Matthes (2004) Version 1.0test5, (c) 1999-2006 Juhana Sadeharju / Olaf Matthes. Originally Gen-ified by Graham Wakefield (2011). 64-bit MSP reference version by Volker Böhm (2016). This evieve version with updated filtering and parameter smooting.

evi.hilbert~.description: Hilbert quadrature (phase shift) filter using an 8th order polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascade.

evi.korgms10~.digest: 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
evi.korgms10~.description:
evi.korgms10~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms10.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms10~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The 'Korg 35' chip was found in the MS-10 and early MS-20 synthesisers - different to the later dual-amplifier Korg OTA chip found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers.

evi.korgms20.select~.digest: Korg OTA dual-amplifier buffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
evi.korgms20.select~.description:
evi.korgms20.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms20_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms20.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This is a fabricated evieve version able to smoothly switch (with a nice 'plop') between 12dB LP and 6dB HP filter types, realised in transposed TPT form. With 2x option.

evi.korgms20~.digest: Korg OTA dual-amplifier modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
evi.korgms20~.description:
evi.korgms20~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms20.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms20~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This Korg filter sits inbetween the more broken evi.korgms10~ and the more stable evi.korgms20.select~. It is aggressive but predictable.

evi.ladder.diode~.digest: TPT Diode nonlinear Ladder filter emulation, similar to the Roland-TB303 filter
evi.ladder.diode~.description:
evi.ladder.diode~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_diode.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.diode~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Unlike the (Moog) Transistor Ladder, the Diode Ladder resonance peaks, rather than scales.

evi.ladder.moog~.digest: Nonlinear Moog Ladder filter emulation, this is the smoothest and most in tune of all the evieve Ladders and handles high resonance very well

evi.ladder.poles~.digest: TPT nonlinear transistor Ladder filter emulation with switchable (interpolated) poles

evi.ladder.transistor~.digest: Nonlinear TPT Transistor Ladder filter emulation
evi.ladder.transistor~.description:
evi.ladder.transistor~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_transistor.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.transistor~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This filter is tuned to be quite 'hot' and aggressive compared to the evi.ladder.moog~

evi.lagsmooth~.digest: Smooth signal ramp generator with logarithmic curve
evi.lagsmooth~.description: Complex ramp generator with smooth logarithmic curve that reaches it's destination within a threshold of -80dB.

evi.limiterfast~.digest: A fast no-lookahead limiter with anti-aliased nonlinear clipping

evi.lockhart.cascade~.digest: Anti-aliased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, selectable up to a cascade of 16 folding sections

evi.lockhart.simple~.digest: Anti-aliased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, selectable up to four stages

evi.logsmooth~.description: A simple and extremely efficient ramp generator with logarithmic curve and ramp time specified in milliseconds.

evi.lores~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP lores~ filter, closely matching the shape and behaviour but implemented as a TPT filter

evi.lorez~.digest: A novel two-pole nonlinear Ladder filter with allpass alignment

evi.lpg~.digest: Buchla Lowpass Gate emulation for your west coast synthesis fun
evi.lpg~.description: Circuit modelled emulation of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate, unique version of a two-pole Sallen and Key filter, based on 'A Digital Model of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate' by Julian Parker and Stefano DAngelo, 2013. In evieve this is all audio rate inputs to control the voltage input to the gate, with additional features such as extra feedback resistors ( boom ) and simultaneous filter outputs. Refactored code for optimal CPU usage.

evi.mattaverb~.digest: True stereo one knob allpass diffuse reverb
evi.mattaverb~.description: A simple allpass diffusion reverb with minimal controls interaction. True stereo input/output, no early reflections, designed wet and spacey but very dampable.

evi.modosc~.digest: A deluxe cosine LFO with range and offset shaping

evi.morph.trap~.digest: A selection of morphing trapezoidal anti-aliased oscillators

evi.morph.tri~.digest: A selection of morphing triangular anti-aliased oscillators

evi.multimode~.digest: 7 simultaneous outputs for all filters available from a linear TPT SVF Topology

evi.onepole.shelving~.digest: Onepole shelving filters with simultaneous outputs

evi.onepole~.digest: Linear trapezoidal integrated onepole filter with simultaneous outputs for lowpass, allpass and highpass

evi.overdrive.atan~.digest: High quality anti-aliased atan-based saturation with shape input to control overdrive

evi.overdrive.sqrt~.digest: High quality anti-aliased passive tanh-like input/output saturation

evi.overdrive.tanh~.digest: High quality anti-aliased tanh-based saturation with drive, input/output wrapping and filter shaping

evi.paf~.digest: A basic 'paf' formant oscillator, very similar to the legacy 'paf~' external

evi.pan~.description: Pan input(s) to output(s) using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'.

evi.phaser.analog~.digest: Analog Phaser effect with multiple stages, filtering and saturation

evi.phaseshift~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP phaseshift~ object as a TPT filter

evi.phasor0~.digest: Zero-rest phasor with settings for reverse and pause

evi.plateverb~.digest: Plate reverb based on yafr2~ with additional filtering and smoothing
evi.plateverb~.description: Based on yafr2~ from MSP ('Plate reverb in the style of Griesinger' by Randy Jones). This version for evieve with dry/wet and eq added, as well as modifications for better filtering, interpolation and smoothing, and zero hold delay changes, Parameters normalised 0..1. Clickless and smooth changes possible for all parameters.

evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs.digest: Coefficients calculator for polyphase IIR halfband allpass quadrature hilbert filter cascade, outputs messages, dict and buffer~ arrays
evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs.description: evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs wraps js code that implements the Laurent de Soras HIIR library. Using this library we can calculate filter coefficients for high quality polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascades. In evieve the filter cascades are realised in standard evieve GenExpr code ( evi.hilbert~ and evi.freqshift.hilbert~).

evi.ramp0~.digest: A bit like MSP ramp~, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause

evi.randy~.digest: Cubic interpolated version of MSP rand~

evi.rcfilter~.digest: TPT nonliner onepole rc filter emulation

evi.rect~.digest: High quality anti-aliased square wave oscillator with PWM

evi.reson~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP reson~ as a TPT filter with fm-able center frequency and auto gain compensation

evi.ringmod.diode~.description: Piece-wise approximation of a 4-diode ring modulator, naive implementation just oversampled for clean anti-aliasing, so not very efficient. But it has it's own interesting sound.

evi.saw~.digest: High quality anti-aliased saw wave oscillator

evi.shaper~.digest: An interpolated choice of even or odd harmonics waveshaping

evi.squine.simple~.digest: A basic implementation of Rasmus Ekman's 'squine wave' oscillator with audio rate modulation

evi.sustainverb~.digest: 16x16 FDN reverb with smooth sustaining effect
evi.sustainverb~.description: This is just Miller Puckette's 'rev3~' but with additional reverb features such as early reflections, filtering improvements and smoothing of parameters whilst maintaining the ability to forever sustain like the original. evi.sustainverb~ also includes multichannel taps of the FDN which can be very useful for surround-ish effects processing.

evi.svf~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP svf~ as a TPT filter

evi.svfsmooth~.digest: Nonlinear TPT SVF filter with audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities

evi.svfsynth~.digest: Beefy nonlinear TPT SVF filter with choice of 12/24dB slope, audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities

evi.teeth~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP teeth~ as a TPT filter

evi.tone.macro~.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for nonlinear cut tone control useful for quick colourisation in your audio chain

evi.tpqm.description: A utility abstraction that allows for value scaling from a linear input map to a linear output map. Map three input points to three output points and linearly scale between them.

evi.transratio.digest: Convert semitones to pitch and vica versa
evi.transratio.description: Like the [transratio] abstraction but with multiple choices for input/output conversion.

evi.tremolo~.digest: Basic Tremolo effect with saturation and choice of LFO shapes

evi.tri~.digest: High quality anti-aliased triangle wave oscillator

evi.vactrol~.description: Analog modelled vactrol opto isolator emulation.

evi.vosim.basic~.digest: A basic implementation of a 'vosim' formant oscillator

evi.warmer~.description: Based on an idea by Tom Szilagyi.

evi.weightingcoeffs.digest: Compute coefficients for A-weighting and other analytical filters and output for cascade~
evi.weightingcoeffs.description: evi.weightingcoeffs is simply a lookup table and is therefore extremely efficient. Coefficients are available for a wide range os samplerates and can therefore be used in a downsampled poly~ (for example).

evi.xfade~.description: Crossfades between inputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. A choice of mono or stereo setups.

evi.zeroxcount~.digest: Like MSP zerox~ with controls for window size and threshold, with simultaneous analysis outputs

evi.zeroxoscnoise~.digest: An automatic crossfading oscillators / noise source via audio analysis, used in vocoders

evi.zitaverb~.digest: True stereo FDN/algorithmic reverb based on 'zitaverb' by Fons Adriaensen
evi.zitaverb~.description: A famous open source reverb algorithm with excellent room realness. GPL v2. The evieve version increases the available RT60 times for special effects, and smooths all parameters, as well as improving the internal filtering.

mc.evi.bands~.digest: Evenly distribute resonant filter bands across a spectrum
mc.evi.bands~.description: An evieve version of the native mc.bands~ abstraction. In evieve the filters are updated to use TPT resonant filters, as well as some minor optimisations and utilities.

mc.evi.listgen.digest: Create message lists with mcwrapper features
mc.evi.listgen.description: Create message lists with mcwrapper features - a patch idea by Todd Ingalls - THANKS!
